purpose: Lightweight visual-convention research and Chunks SVG asset gap decisions; non-normative

features.title: Add via URL
features.detail: LibreTorrent link file is in drawable-xhdpi rather than the normal drawable directory; review source link before using as direct image.

features.title: Pause transfer

observations.meaning: WebUI pause session action; not per-transfer stop

features.detail: Distinguish per-transfer Pause from Stop and session-wide Pause; labels and effects vary by client.

features.title: Delete downloaded data
features.detail: Do not imply that Remove Transfer necessarily deletes payload data; use explicit copy/confirmation.

features.title: Force recheck data
features.detail: Refresh, verify and retry are potentially ambiguous; preserve the semantic distinction.

features.title: Paused / stopped status
features.detail: Do not flatten paused, stopped and completed-inactive states.

observations.meaning: Yellow indicator light; not exclusively queue state

features.title: Progress representation
features.detail: Existing Chunks UI-component progress illustrations also exist outside this icon catalogue.

observations.meaning: Details icon, not a file-selection marker

features.title: Sequential downloading / stream first

observations.meaning: Screen-record-style asset, not verified as sequential control

features.detail: No unambiguous client icon established; treat as text-first design opportunity.

features.title: Archive original torrent source
features.detail: Chunks-specific source-file intake policy; competitor archive asset has a different workflow.

observations.meaning: Speed-dial / gauge icon for alternative rate mode

features.title: Share ratio / seeding limit
features.detail: Transmission ratio-symbolic.svg lives in icons/; gallery should use that path.

features.title: Proxy / VPN or protected route
features.detail: I2P/Tor badges are network markers; don't claim they signify general VPN protection.

features.title: Artwork / metadata identity
features.detail: Owner-approved Chunks differentiator; no established cross-client icon here. Follow current Options design direction.

features.title: Local versus remote environment
features.detail: Use 'Local Device' terminology in UI/specs, not Phone as a general local-device concept.

features.title: Per-transfer turtle / priority
features.detail: Separate speed limiting from per-file priority even if surfaced together.

notes: Six clients selected for diverse ecosystems and available source assets, not proven mathematically optimal.
asset existence does not prove a specific runtime control placement; evidence labels differentiate source asset from UI mapping.
Existing Chunks assets are largely vector drafts and not proof of use in APK.
External icons are linked to their source repos; no third-party vectors are copied into the Chunks source library.
